Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Understanding the divine, transcendental nature of Krishna's appearance and activities liberates an individual from the cycle of birth and death, leading to eternal communion with Him.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Overcoming material bondage and ending repetitive cycles of suffering.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna promises: 'janma karma ca me divyam evam yo vetti tattvatah... mam eti so 'rjuna' (One who truly understands My divine birth and actions is liberated upon leaving the body and comes to Me).
Outcome/Resolution: Gaining deep spiritual insight into divine truth frees the soul from material rebirth.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Liberation from Repetitive Cycles: Breaking free from reactive, recurring patterns of behavior
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cognitive Realignment: Shifting perspective from temporary illusions to ultimate truth
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Attaining Ultimate Purpose: Finding lasting fulfillment beyond immediate external circumstances

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Janma karma ca me divyam (My divine appearance and activities)
Evam yo vetti tattvatah (One who understands this in truth)
Tyaktva deham punar janma naiti (Leaving the body, one does not take birth again)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Deep realization of the divine nature of Krishna's actions and appearance frees a seeker from material rebirth, granting entrance to the spiritual realm.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Transforming how you perceive reality frees you from repetitive, reactive habit loops and instills a sense of purpose.
